instruction:
Task: Navigate to the 'Add Product Feature' section, input details for a new feature (e.g., name, description, select domain, select status, pick dates), add at least one release candidate (description, ID, date, status), and submit the form.
Expected Result: The newly created feature and its release candidate(s) are stored locally and appear listed on the Dashboard view.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
expected: The newly created feature and its release candidate(s) are stored locally and appear listed on the Dashboard view.
